title: Bounded Simulation of a Boolean Turing Machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input and let $w$ be a finite Boolean word. There exist a final register assignment, an input position $p$, an output word $e$, and a bound $B$ such that $B\le 60(k+1)(L+30)(|w|+1)^3$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$ and $L$ is the maximum template length determined by $M$. Starting at the program's initial label with all eleven registers zero, input position zero, and any initial output word $o$, the associated counter program reaches a halted state with the chosen register assignment and input position, appending exactly $e$ to $o$ in at most $B$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
